description: This Java class defines a utility 'Toaster' for displaying styled toast messages (success, error, info) in an Android application, utilizing the Toasty library for custom toasts.

classes.name: Toaster
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to show different styled toast messages (success, error, info) in an Android app.

methods.name: successToast
methods.description: Displays a success toast message with a check mark icon.

methods.name: errorToast
methods.description: Displays an error toast message with an error outline icon.

methods.name: infoToast
methods.description: Displays an informational toast message with neutral styling, used for non-critical info.
